preop_note_claims: Patient has a history of mild asthma, which is infrequent and exercise-induced.
Current medications include Montelukast Sodium 10 mg once daily and Escitalopram 10 mg once daily (with a note that the Escitalopram dose was reduced to 5 mg once daily 3 months ago).
Patient has a known allergy to Penicillin, manifesting as a rash.
Levothyroxine 50 mcg once daily was stopped prior to surgery.
Patient is classified as ASA-PS 2 due to obesity (BMI 28 kg/m^2) and mild asthma.
Airway assessment indicates no anticipated difficulties, and the anesthetic plan includes general anesthesia with spinal anesthesia (combined technique).
handoff_claims: Patient underwent elective laparoscopic appendectomy under general anesthesia with spinal anesthesia (combined technique).
Anticipated postoperative issues include monitoring for respiratory complications due to history of mild asthma and obesity.

Medications of note: Montelukast Sodium and Escitalopram (with recent dose reduction) should be resumed postoperatively as ordered; Levothyroxine was stopped preoperatively and may require resumption based on postoperative assessment.
Patient has a Penicillin allergy (rash), which should be communicated to postoperative care teams.
